opId.description: A unique ID for this call. Reuse it only when retrying the same call.

summary.description: Your plan, or your findings as numbered notes.

verdict.description: Required for plan_review, review and QA steps; null for a plan step.

watchpointNotes.description: Review and QA steps only: one entry per watchpoint file you checked, { path, note } with the note starting ✓ when it holds up or ⚠ when it does not, and why, at most 400 characters. Leave it out of a plan or plan review.

followUps.description: Review, plan review and QA steps only: real problems that should not reject the work (on a later round, ones that are new and not caused by the fix). 10db files each as a task in the Icebox column and names it in your result.

title.description: The outcome, as what is true when it is done.

description.description: What you saw, where, and why it matters.
